entities.name: Luxa River
entities.description: Source of life on Amonkhet, fertilizing the Oashra Valley around Naktamun.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: God who established the Fertile Holding to train initiates.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: God whose viziers calmed the Luxa's waters.

entities.name: Fertile Holding
entities.description: Training ground on the Luxa's banks established by Rhonas.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: Demon revealed at the Gate to the Afterlife in the Hour of Revelation.

entities.name: Sab-Sunen
entities.description: God, new mother of the Luxa.

entities.name: Hour of Revelation
entities.description: When the Gate to the Afterlife opened and Razaketh appeared.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion whose end was followed by the Luxa running clear.

events.summary: In the Hour of Revelation Razaketh was revealed and turned the Luxa to blood.
events.quote: At the demon's command, the Luxa turned to blood.

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion the Luxa began to flow clear under Sab-Sunen.
events.quote: This was caused by the god Sab-Sunen , the new mother of the Luxa.

relations.quote: Rhonas has established an intricate training ground called the Fertile Holding
